items.question: Do you come out to Las Vegas, or do I come to you?
items.answer: Vehicles come to our Boulder City shop for tint, chip repair and windshield work. For homes and offices in the valley, we come to you to measure and install.

items.question: Do you arrange windshield replacement?
items.answer: Yes, it is arranged through us. The glass is ordered to your VIN and the job is booked once it arrives; the replacement itself is done by a glass specialist we work with, and we help with the insurance claim. Chip repair we do in our own shop.

items.question: How long does an auto tint install take?
items.answer: Most vehicles are done the same day.

items.question: When can I roll my windows down after tint?
items.answer: Give the film a few days to fully cure. In summer heat about 24 hours is usually enough, and on cooler days give it longer.
